package.json.purpose: Node.js dependencies and scripts (dev, start, test, seed, admin:create)

README.md.purpose: Project documentation, architecture diagram, and quick start guide

server/index.js.purpose: Express entry point, Helmet CSP, media streaming, daily retention worker

server/config.js.purpose: Environment variables, directories, and master languages metadata

server/db/schema.sql.purpose: SQLite schema with 10 tables, FTS5 virtual table, and triggers

server/db/db.js.purpose: SQLite database connection manager with WAL mode

server/db/seed.js.purpose: Database seeding script with 2 multilingual stories and verified ISRO facts

server/cli/create-admin.js.purpose: CLI script to create admin user with bcrypt cost 12

server/routes/public.js.purpose: Public library API for stories and enabled languages

server/routes/chat.js.purpose: Chat sessions, message history, text and voice note endpoints

server/routes/admin.js.purpose: Protected admin API for stories, translations, audio queue, and settings

server/middleware/requireAdmin.js.purpose: Admin auth verification via HttpOnly JWT session cookie

server/middleware/rateLimit.js.purpose: Rate limiters for public, chat text, chat voice, and login routes

server/middleware/upload.js.purpose: Multer storage configuration for story covers and temporary voice notes

server/services/rag.js.purpose: Retrieval Augmented Generation over SQLite FTS5, stories, and live web search

server/services/websearch.js.purpose: Multi-provider web search (DDG Lite, Wikipedia, Tavily) with Indic query reformulation and TTL cache

server/services/chat.js.purpose: Chat turn orchestration combining STT, RAG, LLM, and TTS

server/services/gnani/tts.js.purpose: Gnani Timbre v2.5 TTS client with SHA256 file caching

server/services/gnani/stt.js.purpose: Gnani Prisma v2.5 speech-to-text client with language detection

server/services/llm/index.js.purpose: OpenAI-compatible LLM client with safe offline fallback

server/services/audio.js.purpose: Sentence splitting and ffmpeg audio conversion utilities

web/index.html.purpose: Public library homepage with language selector and search

web/story.html.purpose: Story audio player with speed cycling, 15s skip, and transcript

web/chat.html.purpose: WhatsApp-style Space Buddy conversational voice & text chat

web/about.html.purpose: Platform mission, voice technology stack, and principles

web/admin/dashboard.html.purpose: Admin dashboard with KPI metrics, audio job status, and stories list

web/admin/story-edit.html.purpose: Multilingual story and narration script editor

web/admin/knowledge.html.purpose: Knowledge base manager with live FTS5 search preview

scripts/backup.sh.purpose: Timestamped backup script for database and audio files

tests/db.test.js.purpose: Tests for database tables, triggers, and settings

tests/auth.test.js.purpose: Tests for admin login, cookies, and protected routes

tests/stories.test.js.purpose: Tests for story CRUD, publishing rules, and FTS5 retrieval

tests/rag-internet.test.js.purpose: Tests for Indic query reformulation, live internet search, RAG integration, and web citations
